projectContext: Sprint 20 focuses on critical test coverage gaps identified after Sprint 19. Primary targets: HealingLogger module (0% coverage), FallbackChain.classify_error edge cases, API Healer private methods, and test infrastructure improvements for CI/CD reliability. Previous testing sprints (13-19) established coverage for conftest fixtures, cache systems, scoring functions, compilation module, and checkpoint serialization. This sprint addresses ~500 LOC of untested healing/fallback logic and introduces test parallelization patterns.
